name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_run:

  flaky-monitor:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.base_branch == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}

        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1

          toolchain: stable
          override: true

        run: cargo fetch

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: cargo run --bin flaky-monitor

      - name: Upload flaky report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: target/flaky-report.json

        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: target/flaky-report.json
